title: Slice restriction preserves evaluation for an arbitrary dualizing object
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small in the module universe, let $\mathcal O$ be a sheaf of commutative rings, and let $U\in\mathcal C$. Use module sheaves and the unbounded derived categories $D(\mathcal O)$ and $D(\mathcal O_U)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], and exact derived slice restriction $r$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-derived-restriction]. Write $H(L,M)=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O}(L,M)$, and $H_U$ for its slice version [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Use derived tensor computed from total tensor complexes after K-flat replacement [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pc-kflat-complex]. Let $\rho_{L,M}:r(L\otimes^{\mathbf L}M)\xrightarrow{\sim}rL\otimes^{\mathbf L}rM$ be the canonical tensor comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] for the localization morphism of topoi $\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C/U)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ with ring map the identity of $\mathcal O_U=\mathcal O|_U$, whose module pullback $M\mapsto M|_U\otimes_{\mathcal O_U}\mathcal O_U$ is identified with $r$ by the unit isomorphism. Let $\eta_{L,M}:rH(L,M)\xrightarrow{\sim}H_U(rL,rM)$ be the slice comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction], normalized on models as follows: if a complex $\mathcal L$ represents $L$ and a K-injective complex $I$ represents $M$ [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], then $rI$ is K-injective [lem-pur-kinjective-restrict-localized], and $\eta_{L,M}$ is the relocalization identification $r\mathcal Hom^\bullet(\mathcal L,I)=\mathcal Hom^\bullet(r\mathcal L,rI)$ of local families of module maps with the same differential [def-pur-hom-complex, def-pur-localized-ringed-site], followed by the canonical identification of the two K-injective representatives $rI$ and $I_U(rM)$ of $rM$. Denote by $\operatorname{ev}_{L,M}:H(L,M)\otimes^{\mathbf L}L\to M$ the tensor-Hom counit, by $\operatorname{tr}$ the natural bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(T\otimes^{\mathbf L}L,M)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(T,H(L,M))$, and by $\sigma_{L,M}$ the Koszul tensor symmetry (on degrees $a,b$, $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{ab}y\otimes x$).

For every $T,L,M\in D(\mathcal O)$ and $f:T\otimes^{\mathbf L}L\to M$, the canonical comparisons satisfy
$$r(\operatorname{ev}_{L,M})\circ\rho_{H(L,M),L}^{-1}=\operatorname{ev}_{rL,rM}\circ(\eta_{L,M}\otimes1),$$
$$\operatorname{tr}_U\bigl(r(f)\circ\rho_{T,L}^{-1}\bigr)=\eta_{L,M}\circ r(\operatorname{tr}(f)),$$
and
$$\rho_{M,L}\circ r(\sigma_{L,M})=\sigma_{rL,rM}\circ\rho_{L,M}.$$
These statements hold for arbitrary unbounded objects; no perfectness or invertibility of evaluation is assumed.
